principles: clean UI cards only when meaningful

fact_rules: Never invent price, availability, year, mileage, location, seller, legal status or terms.
Publishing rights are controlled; do not imply anyone can instantly publish anything.
Do not promise a safe or guaranteed transaction.
For variable listing facts, re-check before reusing old content.
Prefer a concrete listing/category landing page over the site homepage.

channel_rules.instagram: Discovery-first. Reels for reach, carousels for saves/comparison, Stories for daily life. Global visual copy may be short English; captions can localize selectively.
channel_rules.facebook: Local distribution, communities, partner reposts and discussion. Adapt the hook; do not blindly duplicate Instagram copy.
channel_rules.telegram: Fast specific updates, clear titles, actual model/location/category when known, direct landing link.
channel_rules.vk: Russian-language reach, communities and clips. Adapt copy rather than mirroring Facebook.
channel_rules.dzen: Evergreen search/recommendation content: guides, comparisons, explanatory articles connected to live listings.
channel_rules.tenchat: B2B: partners, suppliers, business cases, catalog packaging and local-market expansion.
